'''Kirtarkin''' was a smoky [[Planet/Legends|world]] of pollution and machinery that traditionally served as the customs checkpoint for the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Located along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], Kirtarkin collected billions in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|revenue]] annually from import/export taxes. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rule, the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']] staged from Kirtarkin while patrolling the Greater Javin.

==Description==
Kirtarkin was a smoky, polluted [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kirtarkin system/Legends|Kirtarkin system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], part of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It sat along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and was the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] first stop for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling Rimward from the adjacent [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Kirtarkin lasted thirty [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 450 local days. The planet had a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate and standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. Due to Kirtarkin's widespread [[City/Legends|urban]] pollution, the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was classified as Type II, meaning the use of a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] was suggested.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==History==
A [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Corellian Trade Spine formally ended at the planet [[Javin]] on the edge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Kirtarkin and other worlds lying beyond fell within territory that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] considered then to be [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], an imperfectly surveyed frontier region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] visited only by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and the most daring [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. Countless [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorers tried to expand the Trade Spine's economic opportunities, but their efforts were thwarted by the dominating [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] [[Nebula/Legends|gas clouds]], which proved the greatest impediment to regional [[Astrogation/Legends|navigation]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, the entrepreneur [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] succeeded where his predecessors had failed. Figg's scout ships blazed new hyperspace routes through the Twin Nebulae in the unexplored areas of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] on either side of the Trade Spine, which turned the Greater Javin region into an economic powerhouse. The planet [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] thus found itself at the fortuitous intersection of three lucrative trade lanes, growing from a [[Sleep/Legends|sleepy]] frontier outpost to a bustling [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] world, while Kirtarkin and other surrounding planets followed suit.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

Kirtarkin once fell within the borders of the Republic's Javin sector but was reorganized into the new Anoat sector<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> circa [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which is set during the [[Rebellion era|Rebellion]] and [[New Republic era]]s ([[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]&ndash;[[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]; see {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}}), states that the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] was established in the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] life. The text states that Figg [[Death/Legends|died]] nearly four [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to its setting, thus providing an approximate date of [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]] for the Anoat [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] establishment.</ref> As the sectoral entry point for Rimward travel down the Corellian Trade Spine, Kirtarkin became the customs world for the Twin Nebulae sectors of Anoat and [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kirtarkin served as the staging point for the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']] on its patrols of the Greater Javin.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Inhabitants==
Kirtarkin supported a mixed population of 2 billion [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]], [[Nothoiin (species)/Legends|Nothoiins]], and [[Mugaari]], who governed themselves in appointed councils.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Locations==
An urbanized world of pollution, machinery, and [[Oil/Legends|oil]] slicks, Kirtarkin took in billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each year from tariffs by importing [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] and exporting [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and technology. The planet had three starports, one [[Stellar-class starport|stellar]] and two standard.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kirtarkin was created for the [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|online]] article "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" />
